xmldoc.short_description: Canonical proto3 JSON of a message.

syntax.syntax_item: txt = protobuf.tojson(schema, type, value, 'FieldNames', names, 'Indent', tf)
txt = protobuf.tojson(schema, type, bytes, 'Delimited', true, 'NDJSON', true)

param_input_item.param_description: a schema from protobuf.load and a message type.
a message as a struct or as encoded uint8 bytes; a struct array gives a JSON array.
'json' (default, lowerCamelCase JSON names) or 'proto' (the .proto field names).
logical (default false): one JSON member per line.
logical (default false): write one JSON object per line. With 'Delimited', true, the bytes are read as a length-delimited stream.

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: canonical proto3 JSON, an array for several records.

description.p: protobuf.tojson writes the canonical proto3 JSON of the reference implementation: default values are omitted, 64-bit integers are JSON strings, bytes are base64, enums are names, and Timestamp and Duration are RFC 3339 and seconds strings. A known google.protobuf.Any is written with its "@type" member.
With 'NDJSON', records are written one JSON object per line, which suits logs and line based pipelines. protobuf.fromjson reads both forms back.
